# observe_organization (Data Source)

An organization you belong to: by `id` or `slug`, else the provider's `organization_id`, else your only one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "observe_organization" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slug` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `plan` (String)
- `role` (String) Your role: owner, admin, member or viewer
